answer: The weighting compares an identity's footprint against the population it sits in, and similarity is measured on answer phrasing, timing cadence and declared infrastructure, so an identity that looks like thousands of others earns almost nothing from the stake it posts. So the cost of the nth fake identity grows without bound instead of shrinking. Read it as a garden weighed by relic against every marble nearby: identical marble groups cancel the relic and strip the garden of value, while a marble with its own history keeps both.
